item.title: Version 1.3.26
item.description: Delivery Rename tab: rename the printed mix files in an open Pro Tools session for delivery, with draggable name modules, typed-in stem names saved with the Session Setup Preset. Composer MIDI files (.mid / _MIDI) are imported as MIDI tracks at the top of the session; the tempo map comes from the composer's MIDI, then a CLICK track, then the rough mix. Pro Tools tracks are renamed to the instrument name when the track presets load. Split mono pairs (L/R) are joined into stereo files; surround parts (L R C LFE Ls Rs) are flagged, not joined. Ref Check: click the waveform to move the playhead, and difference markers. Gold scroll bar, new start screen, PAD/ARP synth rules, Name Changer in the guide.
